svg.text: Plan view (A–D, widths roughly to scale) and cross-section (E). Target symbols enlarged.
A · Lay the tape, place scale bars, measure depths, note location and bearing
≥ 6 scale bars along the 30 m, both sides, varied orientation and elevation · depth + time at the centre of every target
B · Pass 1 — forward, camera A over the tape
orange: camera A footprint on the tape · blue: camera B footprint, shifted by the rig spacing (80% overlap)
C · Pass 2 — backward, camera A over the tape (B now shifted to the other side)
passes 1 + 2 together cover ~1.5 m on each side of the tape
D · Pass 3 — zigzag across the tape, out to ~3 m each side
about 5 crossings each way over the 30 m · widens the model and ties passes 1 and 2 together
E · Cross-section: snorkel survey, targets at different elevations, depth at each target centre
snorkeller, rig held below the surface,
reef max 3 m deep · scuba if the rig cannot be kept within ~2 m of the bottom
